title: Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) as a framework for Resident-Visitor Interaction at a Music Festival
content: This study uses action research at a rural community music festival, to explore the community-based exchanges between local community members and visiting musicians and how it aligns with Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) 3, 4, and 11—focusing on good health and well-being, quality education, and sustainable cities and communities, respectively. Adapting the framework of social exchange theory, authoethnography, informal conversations, surveys, and interview with local community members and stakeholders were used in this study. The findings revealed exchanges aligned with the targets of the SDGs, and how reciprocal benefits of cultural interactions foster both individual well-being and collective community resilience, contributing to sustainable community revitalization. The study not only extends current academic discussions on cultural sustainability but also provides practical insights for policymakers and community planners aiming to leverage cultural activities for regional development.
